title: Linear
description: Link a project to Linear: a Linear tab with its issues, an issue's page, comments and status, and handing an issue to the thread's agent.

tools.name: issues
tools.title: List the project's Linear issues
tools.description: List the open issues of the Linear project or team this thread's project is linked to: identifier, status, title, priority and assignee. Narrow it with search (title words or an identifier like ENG-123), mine (only the user's) or closed (include done and canceled).

limit.description: At most this many, newest activity first (default 50).

tools.name: issue
tools.title: Read a Linear issue
tools.description: Read a Linear issue by its identifier (ENG-123): status, priority, assignee, labels, branch name, parent and sub-issues, description and comments.

tools.name: comment
tools.title: Comment on a Linear issue
tools.description: Add a comment (markdown) to a Linear issue, as the user.

tools.name: set_status
tools.title: Move a Linear issue
tools.description: Move a Linear issue to another status of its team's workflow, by the status's name (e.g. In Progress, In Review, Done).

settings.title: API key
settings.description: A personal API key, from Linear → Settings → Security & access.

settings.title: List my issues in progress in the sidebar
